title: Gravitational Enstrophy: Local Geometric Origin and Energy-Cascade Constraints
summary: Two-dimensional incompressible fluids conserve energy and enstrophy in the inviscid limit. Fjørtoft's argument uses this pair to constrain nonlinear energy transfer. We examine the corresponding question in General Relativity using the magnetic Weyl functional $\mathcal Z=\int B_{ab}B^{ab}\sqrtγ\,d^3x$. Its transverse radiativ e part carries an additional frequency-squared weight relative to gravitational-wave energy: $δ\mathcal Z_k\simeqω_k^2W_k$ in the radiation zone, with $W=8πG E_{\rm GW}$.
